name: fix114_cast_timing
verifies: fix-114: in G3 CP 1.75 a cast goes off during its cast motion, not when the button is let go (OnMagicHandleInput: Use1 starts PS_Magic_Cast/PowerCast/QuickCast/Summon, whose _AI_Cast never reads the button; only a power cast let go before 0.7 s restarts as a plain Cast). Heal and Mist (no focus) go off with the button held; Fireball held 3 s powers up and goes off held; Fireball let go after 0.3 s restarts plain and goes off after the button came up; a teleport stone leaves the hero standing normally, no cast pose left on the upper body (owner: arms stuck up after a teleport)
